UserBriefing.title: UserBriefing
UserBriefing.description: A daily or custom 6-pillar NEXUS-7 intelligence briefing saved by an authenticated user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the briefing owner.

editionId.description: Unique identifier of the briefing edition.

dateKey.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) for daily briefing tracking.

focusPillar.description: Primary pillar focus for the briefing.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the briefing was saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the briefing was last updated.

ChatMessageRecord.title: ChatMessageRecord
ChatMessageRecord.description: An interactive NEXUS-7 terminal chat message persisted for an authenticated user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the message owner.

role.description: Sender role in the NEXUS-7 terminal.

modelUsed.description: Gemini model identifier used for the turn.

followUpOptions.description: Bounded list of up to 4 interactive follow-up prompts.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was created.

/user_briefings/{briefingId}.description: Stores user-saved daily and custom 6-pillar intelligence briefings.

/terminal_chats/{messageId}.description: Stores multi-turn NEXUS-7 terminal chat history per authenticated user.
